subject: phy
title: Waves
subtitle: Waves with model-based reasoning, equations, and exam application.
concept: Waves transfer energy and information without net transfer of matter. Understanding wave parameters allows quantitative prediction of wave behavior in many physical systems.
The wave equation v = f lambda links speed, frequency, and wavelength. Changing medium usually changes speed and wavelength while source frequency remains fixed.
Interference and stationary waves arise from superposition. These patterns are central to both qualitative and calculation-based AS questions.
